page.content:
Hall of Hel, where many who die of sickness or age go.

How Helheim connects

  • Character: Hel — Hel rules the hall of Helheim.
  • Location: Yggdrasil — Helheim lies among the dead-worlds of the tree.

What is Helheim?

Helheim, in the north of the dead worlds, is Hel's cold hall. Baldur rides there after Loki's trick; Hermod fails to win him back.

Key threads lead to Hel and Yggdrasil.
